column1: # impulseresponse_bootstrap() fixture data — reference outputs for bootstrap impulse response
# Generated by Python implementation matching timeseries/impulseresponse_bootstrap.m (Kevin Sheppard
# Source: timeseries/impulseresponse_bootstrap.m with timeseries/vectorar.m for VAR estimation
#   1. Estimate VAR(P) via OLS using vectorar()
#   2. Compute VMA(infinity) representation via recursion: Xi(:
#   3. Compute covariance square root sig12 based on sqrttype:
#        a. Resample residuals via block/stationary/IID bootstrap
#        b. Construct artificial time series from resampled errors and estimated parameters
#        c. Re-estimate VAR on bootstrap sample
#   impulses:       K x K x (leads+1) point estimate impulse responses
#   impulseLowerCI: K x K x (leads+1) 2.5th percentile bootstrap lower CI
#   impulseUpperCI: K x K x (leads+1) 97.5th percentile bootstrap upper CI
#   lead:         impulse response horizon h (0 = contemporaneous
#   response_var: index of responding variable i (0-indexed
#   shock_var:    index of shock variable j (0-indexed
